exposure: method for induction of labor (vaginal prostaglandin use)
outcome: mode of delivery (vaginal birth after previous cesarean section or repeat cesarean section)
arterial umbilical cord blood gas pH <7.0
cohort: 1150 women with one previous cesarean section undergoing induction of labor for a singleton pregnancy with cephalic presentation and gestational age of at least 34 weeks, from four delivery units in Stockholm during 2012-2015.
finding: The indication of labor dystocia at a previous cesarean section significantly increased the risk of repeat cesarean section in women undergoing induction of labor.
mod_finding: The indication for a previous cesarean section was found to affect the mode of delivery in subsequent induced labors, with labor dystocia increasing the risk of repeat cesarean section.
